en:
## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a race condition between subagent takeover and context compaction that could cause the compact process to overwrite the subagent's finalized status
- Fixed subagent takeover not properly broadcasting events to the parent narrator's SubagentCard in real time
- Fixed conclusion file not being set up for explore/plan subagents during manual override takeover, causing results to be lost
- Fixed subagent compact restart loop where the outer restart was triggered even after onBeforeTurn had already handled the compact internally
- Improved null-safety for buffered message queue and overseer queue processing
zh-CN:
## 修复

- 修复子代理接管与上下文压缩之间的竞态条件，该问题可能导致压缩流程覆盖子代理已完成的状态
- 修复子代理接管后事件未正确广播到父叙述者的 SubagentCard，导致实时更新缺失
- 修复手动接管 explore/plan 子代理时未正确设置结论文件，导致子代理结果丢失
- 修复子代理压缩后的重启循环问题：当 onBeforeTurn 已在内部处理压缩时，外层仍触发不必要的重启
- 改进缓冲消息队列和 overseer 队列处理的空值安全性
